decisions.rationale: 'Pelizaeus-Merzbacher Disease' names one specific disease with a single definition, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease using the full span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: 'disease' is a very general term used in the title ('the major cause of the disease') and is excluded because it does not name a specific disease or disease class.
'Brain Dysmyelinating Disease' refers to a family of multiple dysmyelinating diseases (the network's disease area), not one specific disease, so it is a Disease Class.
This is a duplicate mention of 'Pelizaeus-Merzbacher Disease' in the abstract sentence, and duplicates within the same sentence or abstract are annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions); What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: 'PMD' is the abbreviation of Pelizaeus-Merzbacher Disease given in parentheses. The long form and the abbreviation are separate synonymous mentions, and this one refers to the same specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (synonymous mentions / abbreviation definitions)

decisions.rationale: 'X-linked developmental defect of myelination' is a categorical description covering a family of X-linked myelination disorders rather than a single specific disease definition, so it is a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Disease Class, cf. 'autosomal recessive disease' example)

decisions.rationale: 'PMD' in 'sporadic cases of PMD' is a later abbreviated mention of Pelizaeus-Merzbacher Disease, a specific disease, and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (synonymous mentions); What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: 'abnormality' is a very general term that does not name a disease, so it is excluded.
